  "pros": [
    "Easy to set up for managing customer support tickets.",
    "Streamlines email processing for customer requests.",
    "Cost-effective solution for a small team."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Experienced software bugs and occasional slowness.",
    "System uptime and accessibility were affected by outages.",
    "Missing some tools in the mobile version."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This administrator, working in logistics for a small company, found LiveAgent to be a generally effective tool for managing customer support during their free trial. They appreciated its ease of setup and ability to streamline email processing for tickets, finding it a cost-effective option. However, the experience was marred by recurrent software bugs, performance issues, and system outages, which created frustration. The lack of full functionality on mobile was also a notable drawback."
